answer: A sybil attack only works when new identities are free, so our economy makes every agent bond stake before requesting work. Tasks are countersigned by random peers re-drawn each epoch, like a sparrow flock that reshuffles perches so strangers can't cluster. Each node keeps a mirror of peer verdicts that anyone can audit, and repeated bad work burns the bond. Reputation is earned per epoch, never bought, so forging a nebula of fake agents costs more than doing honest work.
